h1: Custom 4 XLarge Lanyards for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 4 xlarge lanyards for bulk events. Perfect for large ID badges or heavy keys. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: When you need lanyards that can handle oversized ID badges, multiple keys, or heavy access cards, custom 4 xlarge lanyards provide the extra width and durability required. Unlike standard sizes, these lanyards offer a wider surface area for bold logo imprinting using screen printing or woven methods. They are ideal for trade shows, conferences, and industrial settings where visibility and strength matter. Choose from styles like the 1" Knit-In Lanyard or the 3/4" Nylon Web Lanyard for a reliable, branded solution that stands out.
heroAltText: Custom 4 xlarge lanyards with wide woven strap and metal clip, perfect for bulk orders
